helios_grid_mlt_note: Negative diagnostic: an MLT re-solve on HELIOS geometric (log-P) interfaces does not retain the deep CZ for this opacity (see results/helios_grid_mlt_negative_diagnostic/). Live comparison is independently discretized RCE with matched forcing, not grid-level parity.
benchmark_interpretation: Agreement between independently discretized RCE solutions with matched forcing, opacity law, gravity, EOS/adiabatic gradient, and lower net flux.
note: HELIOS convective adjustment and the finite mixing-length closure are different convection models on the same F_irr=0 column. Numerical gate values are unchanged. Irradiated nested MLT is not this benchmark. No bottom-connected HELIOS CZ is first a geometric-grid/τ-resolution result.

norms.toa_flux_rel: |F_total,TOA - F_int| / F_int and |F_total,BOA - F_int| / F_int, with F_total = F_rad,net + F_conv
norms.max_rel_T: max |T_HELIOS - T_MLT| / max(|T_MLT|, 1 K) on the common log-P domain only (no endpoint extrapolation)
norms.topology: single bottom-connected convective zone; no detached convective cells
